question_text: The equilibrium constant Kc for a reaction is
option_a: The ratio of the concentration of products to reactants at equilibrium
option_b: The ratio of the concentration of reactants to products at equilibrium
option_c: The rate of the forward reaction
option_d: The rate of the reverse reaction
explanation: Kc = [products]/[reactants].

question_text: The value of Kc greater than 1 indicates that
option_a: The equilibrium lies to the right
option_b: The equilibrium lies to the left
explanation: Kc > 1 means more products than reactants.

question_text: The value of Kc less than 1 indicates that
option_a: The equilibrium lies to the right
option_b: The equilibrium lies to the left
explanation: Kc < 1 means more reactants than products.

question_text: The value of Kc equal to 1 indicates that
option_a: The equilibrium lies to the right
option_b: The equilibrium lies to the left
option_c: The concentrations of reactants and products are equal at equilibrium
explanation: Kc = 1 means [products] = [reactants].
